all_92_gates.contract: validity_rate >= 0.99 AND full 94,208-row package AND terminal PASS_FULL_ENV_ASV2_HISTORICAL_VOTES_FROZEN_READY_FOR_SCORING
all_92_gates.positive_signal: relative improvement TRUE vs C0 >= 0.01 in at least one year

behavioral_diagnostics_mandatory_nondeci: mean factor_importance by year and condition
reason-code frequencies by year and condition
mean probability retained on prior party among prior voters
top-choice switch rate among prior voters
mean program-policy-fit weight; no minimum is imposed because real program convergence may make low weight rational

bootstrap.role: diagnostic; frozen point-estimate gates remain decisive

constraints: No post-output changes to prompt, population, policy cards, national context, condition mapping, aggregation, metrics or gates
Program cards are coarse salience summaries; LOW is not opposition
National context is held fixed across true/shuffled within election
Ablations may be run only after the primary full-environment verdict and cannot rescue a failed primary

direct_58_robustness_gates.negative_control_both_years: TRUE RMSE <= FULL_SHUFFLED RMSE in both years
direct_58_robustness_gates.not_materially_worse_both_years: TRUE RMSE <= 1.01*C0 RMSE in both years
direct_58_robustness_gates.positive_signal_not_proxy_confined: for at least one year where ALL_92 relative improvement >=1%, TRUE relative improvement on DIRECT_58 must be >=0

primary_metric: macro_party_share_RMSE over 92x9 cells per year; lower is better
